diagnosis: The Cloudflare Worker routes state inspection requests to a Durable Object instance by invoking env.SESSION_DO.idFromString(durableObjectId) with a hex ID supplied directly in the URL. Although it verifies the presence of an Authorization header, it never checks whether the authenticated user is the legitimate owner of that specific Durable Object session ID. An attacker can enumerate or supply foreign Durable Object IDs to extract in-memory session tokens, user secrets, and auth credentials stored in edge storage.
